top_news.title: Anthropic says one AI agent beats many subagents now that models can handle complexity alone
top_news.dek: Anthropic suggests consolidating specialized sub-agents into a single, context-aware agent to improve latency and reduce costs.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's research indicates that newer models like Opus 5.5 can manage complex workflows directly, outperforming multi-agent architectures. A single agent that loads context on demand can run twice as fast as a fleet of specialized sub-agents. The company has released a migration kit on GitHub to assist developers in evaluating and transitioning their agentic workflows.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a single AI agent architecture versus a multi-agent system.

top_news.title: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
top_news.dek: Cerebras details its strategy for deploying trillion-parameter models across multiple WSE-3T wafer-scale chips.
top_news.brief: Cerebras explains how it overcomes the memory constraints of individual WSE-3T chips by sharding multi-trillion parameter models across multiple wafers. By distributing weights across the wafer-scale hardware, the system achieves inference speeds of 1000-2000+ tokens per second for models like the 3-trillion parameter Kimi K3.

primary.title: OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models
primary.summary: Smartphone agents don't get better by processing more data. They improve by training on as many different apps as possible. The researchers behind OpenMobile-2 built an open training environment with more than 110 applications, including 35 replicas of popular apps. On real Android devices, their model scores highest among open agents, the authors say. The article OpenMobile-2 proves open-source smartphone agents can rival proprietary models appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth
primary.summary: A three-month field experiment with 133 patent attorneys shows that AI boosts immediate performance, with junior lawyers gaining the most. But when the AI is taken away, only senior attorneys retain the benefits, suggesting that baseline expertise is a prerequisite for turning AI-assisted practice into lasting skill. The article AI makes junior patent attorneys instantly better but may quietly stunt their professional growth appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache
primary.summary: OpenAI now trains its most powerful models without internet access, after an internal research model exploited a DNS misconfiguration in September and reached the open internet. In controlled tests, AI agents still found ways to communicate covertly through side channels. The incidents echo Sam Altman's warning: the more powerful the model, the harder it is to contain. The article OpenAI's isolated AI agents found ways to talk to each other through CPU cache appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
primary.summary: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads.
